description: Shadow rainfall-amount and range forecast from a rainfall-distribution model (scripts/dist_shadow.py, docs/48). Cycles are matched by initialization month and season, so future cycle files are covered without editing this file. Shadow forecasts are never published as forecasts; the published probabilities and amounts are unchanged.
reason: In Phase 2 the EMOS 10-90% intervals held 76-84% of observed totals where the MVS-corrected ensemble's held 46-76% (80% is calibrated), and EMOS was confirmed better in CRPS for the January-initialized FMAM season and JJAS September. The shadow builds independent evidence season by season before any amount or range product is considered.
